description: Qwen-frozen graph, task-conditioned learned selection over 1, 2, or 3 supplied relational traversal operators using final answer loss. Mixed-horizon shortest paths generated deterministically from official bAbI Task 19 tree stories. No intermediate hop labels, but final answer string length reveals hop count. Graph pretrained using 2-hop official Task 19 answer labels. All Qwen weights frozen. This is adaptive selection, NOT invention of new operators nor end-to-end Qwen fine-tuning.
notes: Architecture and graph operator menu provided; only operator selection trained
Vocab of sentence/query types shared train/test
Official bAbI Path Finding has only 2-hop answers, so extended 1,3 hop questions are derived using exact BFS; do not report as official bAbI scores
Train/test are disjoint stories but official test has been seen in earlier exploratory experiments
The output answer length discloses number of hops; routing objective thereby has implicit hop supervision even without separate labels
